newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil cenbank denies forex rumors, mum on policy.
newsitem.headline: Brazil cenbank denies forex rumors, mum on policy.

text.p: The Brazilian Central Bank has not produced a report recommending an acceleration in the depreciation of the real currency, a spokesman said.
Central Bank spokesman Manoel Montenegro Neto, reacting to rumors in the foreign exchange markets, said the bank would not comment specifically on its exchange rate policy.
He said a report prepared by private consultants was circulating and that it recommended a sharper rate of depreciation for the real.
"It is not a Central Bank report," he said.
Montenegro added, "The Central Bank acts in the market, and when it does, the market knows what the Central Bank is up to."
Foreign exchange markets were slightly nervous Friday because of the rumors, dealers said.
